name: Zienna Eve career
content: Zienna Eve's career highlights: Danish glamour model since 2012; won a national magazine-cover competition in 2013; Managed by Elite Model Management Miami; MC2 Models and TNG Models; Appeared on most Danish magazine covers; Dolcessa campaign with Jaclyn Swedberg

name: Zienna Eve personal
content: About Zienna Eve: Born August 9, 1994 in Rønne, on the Danish island of Bornholm; 175cm blonde, blue eyes. Famous for publicizing upper-body x-rays to prove her 34F bust is natural; describes her photos as 'sexy but classy'; has one younger sister.

name: Zienna Eve quotes
content: Things Zienna Eve has said: My best asset is my personality. | I am 100% natural (minus one dental filling).

name: Zienna Eve voice
content: Zienna Eve's speaking style: Playful and cheekily open in her Shoot the Centerfold self-interview — flirty first-person facts, loves selfies, Xbox, chocolate. Danish directness with a teasing, confident wink.
